newsitem.title: UK: HSBC underlines confidence in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: HSBC underlines confidence in Hong Kong.

text.p: HSBC Holdings chairman Sir William Purves said on Friday the banking giant was confident Hong Kong would continue to be successful when it is handed back to China by Britain at the end of June.
"(HSBC) is confident that Hong Kong will continue to succeed as a Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China," Purves told shareholders at HSBC's annual meeting.
Purves said while an element of uncertainty was inevitable in every change of political circumstances, "this transition has been carefully prepared over a period of 13 years".
"There have been ups and downs in the preparations and there will continue to be a period of adjustment as the very detailed provisions of the Basic Law are put into effect," he added.
Purves said the people of Hong Kong viewed their future with growing pride and confidence, which was shared by HSBC, which was proud of its contribution to the prosperity of the territory.
"We see excellent commercial opportunities in the territory's future and in its continuing role as an international financial centre for both China and the region," Purves said.
